source_readiness.scope: Pinned upstream source review; no installation, actual production trial, backend qualification or domain proof.
required_repairs: Preserve and translate exact tuple iteration, runtime type identity, dictionaries/strings, imported declarations and the full required module initialization/state closure.
Preserve original unittest fixture/call/assertion/exception semantics; the current shared controls use None returns and nonleading assertions that the inspected translator does not model.
Supply an accepted production-to-model semantic linkage argument; generated-input fidelity comparison cannot supply full-domain translation correctness.

Before any actual trial, pin a fixed source-owned producer under existing lease/ledger/recipe ownership, preserve Codex-only single-agent execution, and exclude automatic fuzz/concurrency/provider dispatch.

invariants: No model-only or sampled equivalence substitution
